mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes and may reduce nafcillin metabolism, while nafcillin may induce CYP450 enzymes, creating a bidirectional interaction that can affect cimetidine levels and nafcillin efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response to nafcillin; consider alternative H2-blocker (famotidine or ranitidine) if cimetidine inhibition of nafcillin metabolism becomes problematic, or monitor cimetidine levels if dose adjustment needed.
